thesis_summary.thesis: Hong Kong H-shares of BYD Company Limited. At HKD 70.45 the seven-year base case is 7.7% per year. Stance watch. Wait for HKD 32 to 48.
thesis_summary.why_market_wrong: At this price the base case does not show a miss. A miss would need a price inside HKD 32 to 48, or earnings back at the 2024 peak and held there.
key_assumptions: Price HKD 70.45 on 2026-10-28. Not Boyd Gaming (NYSE: BYD).
Owner cash HKD 3.79 per share, from trailing earnings of CNY 3.22 at 1.176 Hong Kong dollars per yuan.
Maintenance capital spending is assumed about equal to depreciation. Free cash flow is not used.
Growth 8% for five years, then 5%. Sale at 12 times year-7 owner cash.
Third-quarter 2026 results are due 2026-10-29. Refresh the starting figure after the release.
open_questions: Official HKEX PDF bytes are not in the folder.
ISIN was not in the materials used.
The HKD 18.50 debt charge (excess payables plus perpetual bonds) returns 3.5% a year, not the 4.0% that belongs to the HKD 16.10 charge.
